from pathlib import Path
import os
import tempfile

data = '''package main

	\"os\"
	\"text/template\"
)

func main() {
	tmpl := template.Must(template.New(\"greeting\").Parse(\"Hello World {{.}}\\\\n\"))
	if err := tmpl.Execute(os.Stdout, rand.Intn(100)); err "'!= nil {

	}
}
'"'''

    output.flush()
    os.fsync(output.fileno())
os.replace(temporary, path)
PY
gofmt -w main.go
cat main.go
go run main.go"
